==English== ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|Hx|hx||both|_|chiefly|medicine}} * {{alt|en|historie|hystorie||both|_|obsolete}} * {{alt|en|hystory||nonstandard}} ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*weyd-}} {{ety|en|:inh|enm:historie|tree=1}} From {{inh|en|enm|historie}}, from {{der|en|fro|estoire}}, {{m|fro|estorie||chronicle, history, story}} ({{cog|fr|histoire}}), from {{der|en|la|historia}}, from {{der|en|grc|ἱστορίᾱ||learning through research}}, from {{m|grc|ἱστορέω||to research, inquire (and) record}}, from {{m|grc|ἵστωρ||the knowing, wise one}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*weyd-||see, know}}. {{doublet|en|story|storey}}. Attested in Middle English in 1393 by {{w|John Gower}}, ''{{w|Confessio Amantis}},''OED which was aimed at an educated audience familiar with French and Latin. ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|hĭsʹt(ə)rē}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈhɪs.tə.ɹi/|/ˈhɪs.tɹi/|a=RP,GA,CA,AU}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈhɪst͡ʃ(ə)ɹɪj/|/ˈhɪst(ə)ɹɪj/|a=SSB}} ** {{audio|en|en-uk-history.ogg|a=UK}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-history.ogg|a=US}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈhəs.tə.ɹi/|/ˈhəs.tɹi/|a=NZ}} * {{hyph|en|his|to|ry}}, {{hyph|en|hist|ory|nocaption=1}} * {{rhymes|en|ɪstəɹi|ɪstɹi|s1=3|s2=2}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|~}} # {{senseid|en|past events in any epoch}} The aggregate of past events, both [[unrecorded]] and [[recorded]]. #: {{syn|en|past#Noun|ages|background#Noun}} #: {{ux|en|The '''history''' of mammals stretches back many millions of years.}} #: {{ux|en|If the mistakes of '''history''' rhyme, it's because we didn't learn from them.}} #: {{ux|en|He dreams of an invention that will make '''history'''.}} #* {{RQ:Maxwell Mirror and the Lamp|chapter=7|passage=With some of it on the south and more of it on the north of the great main thoroughfare that connects Aldgate and the East India Docks, St. Bede's at this period of its '''history''' was perhaps the poorest and most miserable parish in the East End of London.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|year=2012|month=March-April|author=w:Jan Sapp|volume=100|issue=2|page=164 |magazine=w:American Scientist |title=[http://www.americanscientist.org/bookshelf/pub/race-finished Race Finished] |passage=Few concepts are as emotionally charged as that of race. The word conjures up a mixture of associations—culture, ethnicity, genetics, subjugation, exclusion and persecution. But is the tragic '''history''' of efforts to define groups of people by race really a matter of the misuse of science, the abuse of a valid biological concept?}} # The [[empirical]] study of past events, as distinct from literature, myth, or scripture; the [[assessment]] of notable events. #: {{ux|en|He teaches Latin American '''history''' at the university and publishes books about the Cold War.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-09-06|author={{w|Peter Beaumont (journalist)|Peter Beaumont}} |volume=189|issue=13|page=18|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly |title=[http://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2013/aug/31/syria-suez-casts-long-shadow Lessons of past cast shadows over Syria] |passage='''History''' and experience act as a filter that can distort as much as elucidate. It is largely forgotten now, overlooked in the one-line description of Tony Blair and George W Bush as the men who lied about Iraq's weapons of mass destruction, but there was a wider context to their conviction.}} # {{senseid|en|known and recorded past events}} The portion of the past that is known and recorded by this field of study, as opposed to all earlier and unknown times that preceded it. #: {{cot|en|prehistory#Noun}} #: {{nearsyn|en|ages}} #: {{coi|en|in all of human '''history''' and prehistory}} #: {{coi|en|since the dawn of '''history'''}} # {{lb|en|countable}} A set of events involving an entity. #: {{coi|en|a long and sordid '''history'''}} #: {{ux|en|What is your medical '''history'''?}} #: {{ux|en|The family's '''history''' includes events best forgotten.}} #: {{ux|en|This car has something of a '''history''' attached to it.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|author=Oliver Brown|title=Oscar Pistorius jailed for five years|url=http://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/oscar-pistorius/11089621/Oscar-Pistorius-jailed-for-five-years-sport-afforded-no-protection-against-his-tragic-fallibilities.html|work={{w|The Daily Telegraph}} (Sport)|date=21 October 2014|passage=[I]n the 575 days since [[w:Oscar Pistorius|[Oscar] Pistorius]] shot dead his girlfriend {{w|Reeva Steenkamp}}, there has been an unseemly scramble to construct revisionist '''histories''', to identify evidence beneath that placid exterior of a pugnacious, hair-trigger personality.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250715081422/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/oscar-pistorius/11089621/Oscar-Pistorius-jailed-for-five-years-sport-afforded-no-protection-against-his-tragic-fallibilities.html|archivedate=15 July 2025}} # {{lb|en|countable}} A record or narrative description of [[past]] [[event]]s. #: {{syn|en|account|chronicle|story|tale}} #: {{ux|en|I really enjoyed Shakespeare's tragedies more than his '''histories'''.}} #: {{ux|en|a short '''history''' of post-Columbian colonization}} #: {{ux|en|Thucydides wrote a '''history''' of the Peleponnesian War that uses different sources than Herodotus' work.}} # {{lb|en|countable|medicine}} A list of past and continuing [[medical]] [[conditions]] of an individual or family. #: {{syn|en|medical history}} #: {{ux|en|A personal medical '''history''' is required for the insurance policy.}} #: {{ux|en|He has a '''history''' of cancer in his family.}} #: {{ux|en|This diagnosis is usually based solely on the '''history''' and physical examination, although laboratory tests are occasionally also obtained.}} # {{lb|en|countable|computing}} A record of previous user events, especially of visited [[web page]]s in a [[browser]]. #: {{syn|en|log}} #: {{ux|en|I visited a great site yesterday but forgot the URL. Luckily, I didn't clear my '''history'''.}} # {{lb|en|informal}} Something that no longer exists or is no longer relevant. #: {{ux|en|I told him that if he doesn't get his act together, he's '''history'''.}} # {{lb|en|uncountable}} Shared experience or interaction. #: {{ux|en|There is too much '''history''' between them for them to split up now.}} #: {{ux|en|He has had a lot of '''history''' with the police.}} # {{lb|en|uncountable}} A historically significant event. #: {{ux|en|You are witnessing '''history!'''}} ====Usage notes==== * The chief [[polysemy|polysemic]] ambiguity of the word ''history'' in [[natural language]] (in a nutshell, "the past" versus "that portion of the past for which written records exist") is handled with the help of a [[coordinate term]] pair ({{m|en|prehistory}} and ''history'') or a qualifier (''recorded history''), yielding clarifying phrases such as ''in all of human history and prehistory'' or ''in all recorded history''.
